title: Buy cards with Intake
subtitle: Scan a customer's cards and see your offer as you go

steps.intro: When a customer brings cards to sell, start an intake on the scanner.
steps.source: Pick where the cards are coming from.
steps.name: Enter the customer's name.
steps.collection: Cards you scan go straight into this collection.
steps.recentCards: Open Recent cards to watch each card arrive with its offer.
steps.scanFirstCard: Hold a card still under the camera. It is identified and added to the intake.
steps.scanMoreCards: Take it away and scan the next one. Each card gets a market price and an offer.
steps.pauseScanning: Pause the scanner when you're done.
steps.offer: The intake panel totals the market value and your cash offer.
steps.finish: When the customer accepts, finish the intake to pay out and add the cards to your stock.
steps.cancel: If they change their mind, cancel the intake instead.
steps.confirmCancel: The scanned cards are removed and nothing is paid.
